declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.run
declarations.source_header: def run (lt : α → α → Bool) : List α → PMF (Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat))

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.run_nil
declarations.source_header:
@[simp] theorem run_nil (lt : α → α → Bool) :
    run lt [] = PMF.pure ([], (1, 0))

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.run_cons
declarations.source_header:
theorem run_cons (lt : α → α → Bool) (head : α) (tail : List α) :
    run lt (head :: tail) =
      PMF.bind (uniformIndex tail.length) fun i =>
        let pivot := (head :: tail)[i.val]'i.isLt
        let rest := (head :: tail).eraseIdx i.val
        PMF.bind (run lt (rest.filter (fun x => lt x pivot))) fun left =>
          PMF.bind (run lt (rest.filter (fun x => !(lt x pivot)))) fun right =>
            PMF.pure (left.1 ++ ([pivot] ++ right.1),
              (left.2.1 + right.2.1 + 4 * rest.length + 3,
                left.2.2 + right.2.2 + left.1.length + 3))

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.run_singleton
declarations.source_header:
@[simp] theorem run_singleton (lt : α → α → Bool) (x : α) :
    run lt [x] = PMF.pure ([x], (5, 3))

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.runOn
declarations.source_header: abbrev runOn [LT κ] [DecidableLT κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α)

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.right_filter_eq
declarations.source_header:
private theorem right_filter_eq [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ)
    (pivot : α) (xs : List α) :
    xs.filter (fun x => !(decide (key x < key pivot))) =
      xs.filter (fun x => decide (key pivot ≤ key x))

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.runOn_cons
declarations.source_header:
theorem runOn_cons [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (head : α) (tail : List α) :
    runOn key (head :: tail) =
      PMF.bind (uniformIndex tail.length) fun i =>
        let pivot := (head :: tail)[i.val]'i.isLt
        let rest := (head :: tail).eraseIdx i.val
        PMF.bind (runOn key (rest.filter (fun x => decide (key x < key pivot)))) fun left =>
          PMF.bind (runOn key (rest.filter (fun x => decide (key pivot ≤ key x)))) fun right =>
            PMF.pure (left.1 ++ ([pivot] ++ right.1),
              (left.2.1 + right.2.1 + 4 * rest.length + 3,
                left.2.2 + right.2.2 + left.1.length + 3))

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.mem_support_run_cons_iff
declarations.source_header:
theorem mem_support_run_cons_iff (lt : α → α → Bool) (head : α) (tail : List α)
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) :
    result ∈ (run lt (head :: tail)).support ↔
      ∃ i : Fin (tail.length + 1),
        let pivot := (head :: tail)[i.val]'i.isLt
        let rest := (head :: tail).eraseIdx i.val
        ∃ left ∈ (run lt (rest.filter (fun x => lt x pivot))).support,
          ∃ right ∈ (run lt (rest.filter (fun x => !(lt x pivot)))).support,
            result = (left.1 ++ ([pivot] ++ right.1),
              (left.2.1 + right.2.1 + 4 * rest.length + 3,
                left.2.2 + right.2.2 + left.1.length + 3))

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.run_perm
declarations.source_header:
theorem run_perm (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) (hr : result ∈ (run lt xs).support) :
    result.1.Perm xs

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.run_length
declarations.source_header:
theorem run_length (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) (hr : result ∈ (run lt xs).support) :
    result.1.length = xs.length := (run_perm lt xs result hr).length_eq

/-- Comparator compatibility is local to this input, and the observed key
relation needs only transitivity. This is not a stability statement. -/
theorem run_sorted_compatible_on [LE κ] [IsTrans κ (· ≤ ·)]
    (key : α → κ) (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (hc : ∀ a ∈ xs, ∀ b ∈ xs, (lt a b = true → key a ≤ key b) ∧
      (lt a b = false → key b ≤ key a))
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) (hr : result ∈ (run lt xs).support) :
    KeySorted key result.1

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.run_sorted_compatible_on
declarations.source_header:
theorem run_sorted_compatible_on [LE κ] [IsTrans κ (· ≤ ·)]
    (key : α → κ) (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (hc : ∀ a ∈ xs, ∀ b ∈ xs, (lt a b = true → key a ≤ key b) ∧
      (lt a b = false → key b ≤ key a))
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) (hr : result ∈ (run lt xs).support) :
    KeySorted key result.1

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.runOn_correct
declarations.source_header:
theorem runOn_correct [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α)
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) (hr : result ∈ (runOn key xs).support) :
    KeySorted key result.1 ∧ result.1.Perm xs

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.support_cost_bounds
declarations.source_header:
private theorem support_cost_bounds (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) (hr : result ∈ (run lt xs).support) :
    result.2.1 ≤ 2 * xs.length ^ 2 + 2 * xs.length + 1 ∧
      3 * xs.length ≤ result.2.2 ∧
      2 * result.2.2 ≤ xs.length ^ 2 + 5 * xs.length ∧
      result.2.2 ≤ result.2.1

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.exerciseCost_le
declarations.source_header:
theorem exerciseCost_le (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) (hr : result ∈ (run lt xs).support) :
    result.2.1 ≤ 2 * xs.length ^ 2 + 2 * xs.length + 1

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.appendCost_lower
declarations.source_header:
theorem appendCost_lower (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) (hr : result ∈ (run lt xs).support) :
    3 * xs.length ≤ result.2.2 := (support_cost_bounds lt xs result hr).2.1

theorem appendCost_double_le (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) (hr : result ∈ (run lt xs).support) :
    2 * result.2.2 ≤ xs.length ^ 2 + 5 * xs.length

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.appendCost_double_le
declarations.source_header:
theorem appendCost_double_le (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) (hr : result ∈ (run lt xs).support) :
    2 * result.2.2 ≤ xs.length ^ 2 + 5 * xs.length

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.appendCost_le_exerciseCost
declarations.source_header:
theorem appendCost_le_exerciseCost (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) (hr : result ∈ (run lt xs).support) :
    result.2.2 ≤ result.2.1 := (support_cost_bounds lt xs result hr).2.2.2

/-- Append-inclusive source-body observation. Selection, lookup/removal and
random bits are still outside this tariff. -/
theorem literalCost_comparison (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) (hr : result ∈ (run lt xs).support) :
    result.2.1 ≤ result.2.1 + result.2.2 ∧
      result.2.1 + result.2.2 ≤ 2 * result.2.1

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.literalCost_comparison
declarations.source_header:
theorem literalCost_comparison (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) (hr : result ∈ (run lt xs).support) :

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.literalCost_double_le
declarations.source_header:
theorem literalCost_double_le (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) (hr : result ∈ (run lt xs).support) :
    2 * (result.2.1 + result.2.2) ≤ 5 * xs.length ^ 2 + 9 * xs.length + 2

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.literalCost_le
declarations.source_header:
theorem literalCost_le (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (result : Measured (List α) (Nat × Nat)) (hr : result ∈ (run lt xs).support) :
    result.2.1 + result.2.2 ≤ (5 * xs.length ^ 2 + 9 * xs.length + 2) / 2

declarations.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.exerciseLaw_cons
declarations.source_header:
theorem exerciseLaw_cons (lt : α → α → Bool) (head : α) (tail : List α) :
    exerciseLaw lt (head :: tail) =
      PMF.bind (uniformIndex tail.length) fun i =>
        let pivot := (head :: tail)[i.val]'i.isLt
        let rest := (head :: tail).eraseIdx i.val
        PMF.bind (exerciseLaw lt (rest.filter (fun x => lt x pivot))) fun left =>
          PMF.bind (exerciseLaw lt (rest.filter (fun x => !(lt x pivot)))) fun right =>
            PMF.pure (left + right + 4 * rest.length + 3)
